# Elizabeth Russell & Uncle Jim

- [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md) — Friend of — [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) — great cronies all their lives · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P55](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0055)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Captain Jim warmly accepts Anne's invitation to visit, explaining that she belongs to "the race that knows [Joseph](../character/joseph.md)." As the evening concludes, Captain Jim and the other guests depart while admiring the moonlit harbor and Lombardy trees. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) stroll through their garden together, enjoying the peaceful night and their home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P60](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0060), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P64](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0064)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visit Captain Jim at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, encountering the oddly bearded [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) along the lane. During their evening visit, Captain Jim explains Marshall's political vow, shares tea and stories about his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), and shows them around the lighthouse.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038)_

> Captain Jim explains how he rescued the First Mate and shares stories about his past adventures with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). After showing off his collection of curios and telling captivating tales, Captain Jim bids them farewell, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) reflect on his remarkable life as they walk home.
>
